items.html: Correction 7 is the two holy apples, which are the two cheeks beneath the eyes, on the two sides of the nose, and they are free of hair entirely; and they themselves are but of the thirteen corrections of the Galgalta, as above. However, their being free of hair is what is called the seventh correction of the beard, for the cheeks themselves are of the count of the thirteen of the Galgalta.
